About Wayra | Telefónica's Corporate Venture Capital Perks Reports About us en EN ES PT Home investment services startups News contact Perks Activation Programme About Us Link About us Since 2011, Wayra has been connecting startups with Telefónica to drive innovation and generate real business impact. Today, Wayra operates mainly in Spain, Germany, the United Kingdom and Brazil, while also working across other markets in Europe and Latin America. We invest in startups and help them scale by collaborating directly with Telefónica’s business units through our venture-client model. Originally launched as a startup accelerator, Wayra evolved in 2018 into Telefónica’s Corporate Venture Capital, bringing together the Group’s investment and open innovation initiatives and supporting corporations and entrepreneurial ecosystems worldwide. We are the Corporate Venture Capital of Telefónica. Our mission is to foster innovation and drive progress in startups and facilitating their collaboration with organizations to generate impact in Spain, Germany, the United Kingdom and Brazil . The first edition of ACCIÓN attracted more than 100 registered healthcare professionals and startups. AstraZeneca Spain , in collaboration with Wayra , Telefónica’s corporate venture capital, and Kunsen , an investor specialising in digital health and startup acceleration, has announced the selection of the startup Sycai Medical to carry out the hospital pilot of ACCIÓN, the accelerator for innovative healthcare initiatives that the three companies launched in November 2025.
